title: MONSTER V5 Step 3 - Event-Driven Resume
scope: Add a repository-backed event-resume cursor that binds watches to exact detached-continuation packet hashes, converts only material state transitions into one-shot ready receipts, blocks duplicate event replay, and never grants mutation authority. Supported events cover workflow terminal state, lease release, PR merge, deployment terminal state, frozen-registry change, artifact appearance, blocker clear, and generic ready/equality transitions.
proof_policy: Exact PR head must pass permanent DevSystem contract and final gate, merge through the single Step-3 PR, merged-main DevSystem proof and terminal receipt must pass, the dedicated authoritative event-resume state ref must be initialized, MONSTER_V5_STEP3 must be content-addressed in the frozen registry, final truth must publish Step 3 FROZEN with START_MONSTER_V5_STEP4, and only the Step-3 scope lease may be released.
